summary: Rebuilt the B&S Case Reserve Adequacy Adjustment Method tab to match the Settlement Rate design, with ResQ's calculation views and in-grid selections.
details: The Method tab now shows the ResQ sub-tabs in order: Reported, Closed, Open, Paid Claims, Incurred Claims, Case Reserves, Avg. Case Reserves, Avg. Paid, Avg. Selections, Adj. Avg. Case Reserves, and Adj. Incurred, each with its ResQ caption line.

Avg. Selections replaces the dropdown strip with the two ResQ selection grids: click a value to select an estimator for a development period, click a row label to select it everywhere, and type into the User Value row.
Current Average Case Reserves adds the Loess (n) estimator and its Loess Span stepper, and the span is saved with the method and imported from ResQ.
The Details tab lists the sources in the ResQ order: Paid Claims, Incurred Claims, Reported Claim Counts, Closed Claim Counts.
